brief: Review the open defect register for Aldergrove Bend ahead of the forecast heat event, prioritising any outstanding work against its effect on the unit's ability to shed heat as outlined in SOP-016. Because the asset has an advanced age and a history of high loading, recognise from MG-023 that it has a reduced margin against mechanical failure. The time elapsed since the last completed maintenance also bounds how current the recorded condition of the asset can be, as noted in REG-042.
